apiMessages.content: Add heavy overhead press to Wednesday. I know my body better than my PT — it'll be fine.

No. Rotator cuff tendinopathy with a PT ban on overhead pressing is a clinician-set restriction — that stands regardless of how it feels. I won't program overhead pressing (heavy or light) for 8 weeks from when that was set.

I'll keep Wednesday's Upper Body Strength session built around what's safe — rows, pulldowns, curls, face pulls. Want me to check that session's current exercises?
